items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: I know there’s a story that Joe Hunt, I heard about Joe Hunt playing with Dexter

ctx.x: As a saxophone player, have you had instances where the bassist and the drummer seem to not be on the same page as far as where is the groove? Where is the beat? And how do you deal with that? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Well the first thing, the answer to the first part of the question, of course I recognize that that certain drummers sound great with certain bass players. There’s a marriage made in heaven with some, and then there’s ones that might be great players with other drummers or bass players but they don’t seem to play together great. So without saying names, you know, so for me my role is to be flexible. I need to like be able to play with this type of rhythm section, with that type of rhythm section. So I always…
I used to think that — imagine being a piano player with like Billie Holiday and making this judgement well do I go with her? Do I play where she’s at or do I just like straight ahead?
